name: The India Cements Limited
summary: The India Cements Limited manufactures and sells cement and cement related products in India. It offers cements under the Conkrete Super King, Coromandel King, Sankar Super Power, Raasi Gold, Halo Super King brands; specialty cements; and ready-mix concrete. The company also engages in the generation of power from windmills and thermal power plants; and provision of freight services, as well as sale of clinker products. The company was incorporated in 1946 and is based in Chennai, India. The India Cements Limited operates as a subsidiary of UltraTech Cement Limited.
